37.exact_result: For every usc obstacle, the full local-Fubini--Study/semipositive-real-PL regularized envelope is classically psh on products of a perfected-bijective-normalization strict curve with a smooth geometrically connected projective factor, and on analytic projective bundles over such curves. Exact global competitor descent and ordinary projection/regularization compatibility are proved. Concrete normal domains and nonnormal geometrically unibranch cusp products are realized. Explicit continuous-obstacle failures are proved for split branches, codimension-two seminormal point gluings including a single irreducible bidisc with two points pinched, and the irreducible nonsplit quadratic-node surface over Q_3.
concrete_gaps: No sharp necessary-and-sufficient hypotheses for arbitrary normal or geometrically unibranch higher-dimensional analytic domains.
No general positivity theorem for normal higher-dimensional affinoids beyond the proved projective-fiber sectors.
No full-family scalar-extension cofinality or general scalar regularization compatibility theorem.
The explicit codimension-two point pinching is not asserted to equal the supplied book's exact construction.
No claim of CLD-stage positivity or continuity for arbitrary full-family envelopes.

38.exact_result: Every finite continuous obstacle has a continuous raw and regularized full local-Fubini--Study/semipositive-real-PL envelope on the displayed compact strict rational curve affinoids over a complete algebraically closed nontrivially valued field and on their products with analytic projective space; exact compatibility for every analytic scalar extension of each obstacle. The split node and its projective products give a freshly proved full-family discontinuity obstruction.
concrete_gaps: No sharp necessary-and-sufficient classification of good strict analytic domains.
No theorem for every normal or geometrically unibranch higher-dimensional domain.
No continuity theorem for the entire perfected-unibranch curve range or arbitrary obstacles over nonalgebraically closed base fields.
General semistable affinoid graph realization/global cofinality beyond the explicit rational trees is not proved.
Nonsplit and codimension-two singularities and general necessity remain unclassified.
Projective-space products are covered; closed-polydisc products and arbitrary proper factors are not covered.
